# Documint

Documint is a document generation platform that allows you to create dynamic documents from templates.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/documint/.

## Actions

- **Delete Template**: Permanently delete a single template by its id.
- **Get Template** (read-only): Retrieve a single template by its id.
- **List Documents** (read-only): List all documents in the authenticated user's account.
- **List Templates** (read-only): List all templates in the authenticated user's account.
- **Update Template**: Update a single template by its id.
